sections.name: File setup, QA
sections.title: Imports and types
sections.what: Brings in the AI helper, sets a two-minute limit, and defines the shape of one question and answer.
sections.why: Needed for the AI call and the data format.

sections.name: POST (part 1)
sections.title: Build the refinement prompt
sections.what: Reads the inputs, summarizes the profile, and writes the prompt with the current answers and the instruction.
sections.why: Gives the AI enough context to keep edits accurate.
sections.watch_out: The profile summary uses only the first three experience entries.

sections.name: POST (part 2)
sections.title: Call the AI and return answers
sections.what: Calls the AI and returns the updated answers, or the originals if the AI gives nothing back.
sections.why: Avoids losing answers when the AI returns nothing.
sections.watch_out: The fallback covers only missing results, so a shortened list is returned as it is.

summary: Edits a set of written application answers according to one instruction, changing only what the instruction asks.
purpose: Lets the user adjust answers without rewriting them.
why: Likely reason: a single instruction such as shorten all answers is faster than rewriting each one.
how: Formats the answers and a short profile summary, writes the instruction and rules into a prompt, asks the AI for the updated list, and returns it. If the AI returns no list, the original answers are returned.
inputs: The current answers, the instruction, optional job context, the profile, and provider settings.
outputs: The updated answers list, or an error with status 400 or 500.
risks: The AI could change answers beyond what was asked, or drop some. The fallback only applies when no list comes back, not when the list is shorter than expected.
debug: Compare the returned answers with the input. Check the instruction wording if the wrong answers change.
